title: Add proportional signal dampener and stochastic fallback harness for canary regressions
author: Ethan Cho
description:
Motivation: Canary evaluators are sensitive to transient noise in production traffic (burst variance, ephemeral backend pressure). This PR introduces two complementary mechanisms: (1) a proportional signal dampener that adaptively reduces the weight of short-lived deviations based on traffic variance and cohort size, and (2) a stochastic fallback harness that probabilistically exercises safe rollback/fallback paths under uncertain signals to bound blast radius during gradual rollouts. Goals: reduce false-positive regressions, make rollouts more robust to bursty traffic, and provide a controlled, measurable fallback that surfaces real regressions without causing widespread rollbacks.

Changes included (high level): - New canary evaluator module: canary/dampener.py implements a proportional dampening factor computed from per-cohort throughput variance, effective sample size, and configured sensitivity profiles. Dampener integrates as a pluggable preprocessor for metric deltas. - Stochastic fallback harness: canary/fallback_harness.py and scheduler changes that allow the controller to route a small, adjustable fraction of canary traffic to a conservative fallback path (lower throughput model variant, cached responses, or circuit-broken replicas) when confidence sits in an uncertainty band. The harness uses a seeded RNG and configurable ramp schedules to make experiments reproducible. - Probe scheduler adjustments: probe/scheduler.py changed to emit variance-aware probe windows and to surface metadata used by the dampener. - Canary evaluator tests and new synthetic workload generator: perf/tests/synth_traffic.py to reproduce variance & burst scenarios. - Metrics + dashboards: observability/dashboards/canary-dampener.json adds visualization panels for dampener coefficient, uncertainty band, and fallback activation rate. - Rollout policy additions: rollout/policies.md documents new knobs and recommended defaults.

Checklist: - [x] Core algorithm implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration tests with probe scheduler - [x] Performance canary simulation harness - [x] Dashboard panels and alert rules - [x] Backwards-compatible config with opt-in via feature flag - [x] Documentation for SRE runbook

Testing notes: Unit + integration test matrix run in CI (linux/py38, linux/py310). Added a small perf job that runs the synthetic burst scenarios and validates that false-positive rate decreases vs baseline in controlled runs. Local validation with a shadow deployment on staging showed a 68% reduction in canary-triggered rollbacks for bursty traffic shapes and no measurable increase in detection latency for sustained regressions.

Related: ENG-1882 (reduce noisy canary signals), SUP-4221 (customer-reported spurious rollbacks during weekday traffic spikes).

review_comments: Priya Kapoor (review): Algorithm looks reasonable. Two asks: (1) can we add an opt-out path for small tenants that may see high variance by design? (2) add more comments around the dampener coefficient equation so SREs can tune it.
Ethan Cho (author reply): Added tenant whitelist opt-out via config; expanded docstring and inline math comments in dampener.py. Also added sample values for edge cases.
Samir Nair (review): The stochastic fallback is clever but please ensure RNG seeding is surfaced for reproducibility in telemetry. Also flagged a small race in scheduler updates.
Ethan Cho (author reply): Exposed seed via config and ensured scheduler update is protected by the existing probe mutex. Added unit test asserting determinism for a given seed.
Grace Liu (review): CI perf job flaky on first run; reran and green. Please add a note in rollout docs about expected fallback activation rates to set realistic SLOs.
Ethan Cho: Added guidance to rollout/policies.md and the runbook. Requested a final pass from Priya.
merge_outcome: Merged by Priya Kapoor via squash-merge on 2025-09-18. Merge commit message: 'Add proportional dampener + stochastic fallback harness; tests/docs'.
release_notes: Added adaptive canary dampener to reduce false positives from bursty traffic and a stochastic fallback harness to bound rollback blast radius. Feature is behind a feature-flag and defaults to opt-in for new rollouts. Includes observability panels and runbook guidance.
backport_notes: Consider backporting to release/2025-09 for customers experiencing spurious rollbacks; requires gating the feature flag by default off in stable channel.
